title: fix: route Mistral Small 4 directly
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Routes the existing Mistral Small 4 public ID and aliases to Mistral direct API using the same mistral-small-2603 checkpoint.
- Prices the primary at Mistral direct USD 0.15/USD 0.60 per million input/output-token rates, with multiplier 1.
- Keeps OpenRouter as a hidden same-checkpoint fallback, with its 5.5% fee applied only when the fallback is used.

Tests:
- npx tsc --noEmit
- npx vitest run test/static-provider-fallbacks.test.ts test/text/utils/modelResolver.test.ts
- npm run build:staging

gist.headline: Mistral gets a direct flight
gist.blurb: Mistral Small 4 now flies straight to Mistral’s own API, with OpenRouter tucked behind the hedge as a same-checkpoint fallback. Fewer scenic routes for your tokens.
gist.summary: Routed the existing Mistral Small 4 public ID and aliases directly to Mistral’s mistral-small-2603 checkpoint at $0.15/M input and $0.60/M output tokens, while retaining OpenRouter as a hidden 5.5%-fee fallback.
gist.impact: Apps using Mistral Small 4 now receive the direct-provider pricing and route by default, with the same checkpoint still available through an automatic fallback when needed.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-postal scene represents direct model routing: Polli carries a sealed message along a clearly marked path from a retro terminal to a Mistral-branded windmill/server, while a smaller covered side path leads to an OpenRouter fallback gate. The direct path should be visibly simple and primary, with code-plants and price-tag flowers suggesting token-rate clarity.
